tools.name: marketplace.describe
tools.description: FREE, read-only marketplace overview. Use this first for marketplace-specific capability commerce, fee policy, creator rights, payment rails, and active catalog counts; use provider.describe for the broader CrossingKey provider and legacy offer surface.

tools.name: provider.register
tools.description: FREE public intake. Submit a pending marketplace provider application; this creates no credential, approval, payment, ownership transfer, or active capability. Use creator.apply instead when submitting an asset or body of work that still needs a capability model.

tools.name: provider.get
tools.description: FREE. Public active provider metadata. Pending applications require owner or administrator authorization.

tools.name: capability.get
tools.description: FREE. Use name for legacy deterministic capability metadata or capabilityId for public marketplace metadata, rights and provenance.

tools.name: capability.search
tools.description: FREE MARKETPLACE FILTERED DISCOVERY ONLY. Search active public marketplace capabilities when one or more filters are known: text, category, provider, delivery type, or price. Metadata is free; purchased execution and deliverables are not. Do NOT use for unfiltered browsing; use catalog.list. Do NOT

tools.name: catalog.list
tools.description: FREE MARKETPLACE UNFILTERED DISCOVERY ONLY. Page through active public marketplace capabilities when no search filters are needed. Metadata is free; execution, entitlement, delivery, and purchased output remain gated. Do NOT use for filtered discovery; use capability.search. Do NOT use for CrossingK

tools.name: commerce.quote
tools.description: FREE MARKETPLACE PAYMENT QUOTE ONLY. After selecting an active marketplace capabilityId, return authoritative gross price, CrossingKey fee, provider share, and x402 v1/v2 payment requirements. A quote grants no entitlement and performs no execution. Do NOT use for first-party paid capabilities; use

tools.name: creator.apply
tools.description: FREE WRITE. Private creator intake for assets needing a capability model. No ownership transfer and AI training defaults false.

tools.name: provider.describe
tools.description: FREE read-only provider and commerce policy discovery. Use this before selecting an offer or capability.

tools.name: offers.list
tools.description: FREE read-only public offer and capability discovery. This tool never starts payment or execution.

tools.name: requirements.check
tools.description: FREE read-only requirements check. This tool never authorizes or starts payment or execution.

tools.name: cost.estimate
tools.description: FREE read-only cost estimate. This tool never creates checkout, reserves funds, or contacts a facilitator.

tools.name: result.preview
tools.description: FREE read-only result-shape preview. This tool never executes a capability or creates an entitlement or receipt.

tools.name: execution.preflight
tools.description: FREE read-only execution preflight. Returns READY_FOR_HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION only; it never authorizes, purchases, settles, executes, or creates records.

tools.name: credits.options
tools.description: FREE read-only prepaid request-credit pack options. Lists available credit packs with identifiers and credit amounts. Purchasing happens via checkout; this tool never starts payment or creates accounts.

tools.name: x402.compatibility_audit
tools.description: PAID $1.00 USDC on Base via x402. Audits an x402 endpoint for v1/v2 compatibility defects. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

tools.name: mcp.schema_audit
tools.description: PAID $1.00 USDC on Base via x402. Scores supplied MCP tool schemas for discoverability, descriptions, and bounded input contracts. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

tools.name: openapi.quality_audit
tools.description: PAID $1.00 USDC on Base via x402. Evaluates structural quality and required fields in an OpenAPI document. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

tools.name: machine_commerce.readiness_audit
tools.description: PAID $2.00 USDC on Base via x402. Checks machine-commerce discovery and health surfaces. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

tools.name: artifact.integrity_manifest
tools.description: PAID $0.10 USDC on Base via x402. Creates deterministic SHA-256 entries and a root manifest hash for supplied text artifacts. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

tools.name: xkey.validate
tools.description: PAID prepaid-credit XKEY intake validation. Requires an authenticated ck_ principal and commits one credit only on verified success. Discovery is free; execution is not.
